description:
Upcoming tax sales and sheriff sales in the next 21 days in counties HeritageDeed title-searches, each with
        how many properties are listed and how many were already pre-checked with a title search: how many carry an
        open mortgage (on a mortgage foreclosure the loan being foreclosed is not counted), a second mortgage, a lien,
        a lis pendens, open code violations or a high risk score, and how many came back clear. Optional `state`
        (two-letter code or name). Counts only: no addresses or owners. The per-property results come with the
        county's auction pack (buy_county_list_pass, product 'auction_pack').
name: upcoming_auction_sales
